stages.name: process
stages.claim: we see the update, not whom i heeded; the update points back at the likely source, B_ej

stages.name: smooth_mechanism
stages.claim: each neighbour shifts the same curve by its offset from the neighbourhood mean

stages.name: smooth_naive
stages.claim: binned against the mean discrepancy, the updates trace a smoother, flatter curve

stages.name: smooth_model
stages.claim: weighting each neighbour by its responsibility B_ej puts the data back on the kernel

stages.name: repulsion_mechanism
stages.claim: if i heeds a neighbour on the far side of the crowd, it moves away from the mean

stages.name: repulsion_naive
stages.claim: binned against the mean discrepancy, an attractive kernel looks repulsive

stages.name: repulsion_model
stages.claim: weighted by B_ej, the same updates sit on the attractive kernel
